column1: # What each detector watches, in ATT&CK technique IDs (internal/attack/enterprise.tsv). A tag says what a detector looks
# for, never that a technique is covered. The reason for every row, and what is not watched: docs/ATTACK.md.
# Columns (tab-separated): detector, event kind, condition on one alert field, technique IDs (comma-separated).
# "*" matches anything; a condition is key=value, and key=* means the field is there and not empty.
# The first row that matches an alert decides; an alert no row matches has no tags.
